affected_predicate.description: A November PDF whose filename contains invoice or receipt is present as a copied file in Finance/invoice.

competing_trace_defects.description: The agent declared completion while the visibly opened Finance/invoice folder displayed "No items" and no paste or copy-confirmation action had occurred there.

After choosing "Copy to...", the agent pressed the destination picker's COPY button while still in Downloads, returning to the ordinary Downloads view instead of navigating to Finance/invoice before confirming the copy destination.

chains.rationale: At the reuse target, the current GUI already showed the device root, and the action correctly entered Finance. Thus the stale statement about needing to enter the root was merely concurrent with the observed navigation and introduced no visible harmful mechanism requiring recovery. Later steps created and opened Finance/invoice, but the terminal view visibly showed "No items"; the predicate was therefore observably unsatisfied. The earlier confirmation of COPY while still in Downloads and the later false completion are independently observable competing defects, not effects attributed to this reuse target.

summary: The strict-MHR reuse was stale but caused no visible local harm: the target correctly entered Finance from the already-open device root. The destination predicate was visibly unsatisfied at the terminal trace, with independently observable defects consisting of confirming the copy destination in Downloads and later declaring completion in an empty Finance/invoice folder.
